BRANCH C (adverse ruling): do not catch it; re-court at $55-65 against a rebuilt FY27. No premium selling (taxable book doctrine); GTC limit ladders only.

COIN.ruling: ONE combined 'retail speculative flow' axis cap, not two independent name caps — ~62% of a combined position's variance is a single shared factor. BUT the fundamental exposures diverge radically: COIN ~100% crypto revenue vs HOOD 7.6%. The correlation is a POSITIONING/CLASSIFICATION artifact, not a fundamental one — which IS the mispricing. Consequence: they are not substitutes and not a diversifier pair, they are two legs of one trade. Pure crypto mean-reversion = COIN. The 'market mis-classifies HOOD as crypto' trade = LONG HOOD / SHORT COIN, which strips the shared factor and isolates the revenue-mix divergence exactly (flagged as the pure expression; shorting is outside the taxable book's normal instrument set, not recommended here). Owning BOTH long is the one combination that captures neither edge while paying for both risks.

BTC.ruling: the market assigns HOOD a 0.83 bitcoin beta against a business where crypto is 7.6% of revenue and shrinking

household_ai_complex.ruling: LARGER overlap than COIN and the binding sizing constraint. Household already carries ~$5.2M / 26% AI-complex exposure against the frozen AI-BREAK p=0.45 by 2027-12-31. HOOD is not an AI name but is a 2-3x-beta expression of retail equity risk appetite = a levered version of the same drawdown. Does entry require the cycle holding? BUSINESS THESIS: NO — HOOD proved through a 49% BTC crash that the franchise diversifies. PATH: EMPHATICALLY YES — a -20% index event implies -37% to -60% on HOOD. Does the de-rate already price the break? NO — it prices the CRYPTO break, which has already happened; the equity-flow break is unpriced and untested because SPX is +11% over the entire window.

edge_explainer.market_believes: HOOD is a levered retail-crypto proxy. Bitcoin is -49% off its cycle top so HOOD deserves to be -41%, and the July print, however good, does not change the classification.
edge_explainer.we_believe: The classification is stale. Crypto is 7.6% of revenue and shrinking; the natural experiment refutes the proxy thesis — BTC fell 49% while HOOD set records in every non-crypto line (equity notional +85%, options contracts +50%, event contracts +10x, net deposits a record $21.7bn) and IBKR, the closest no-crypto retail broker, ROSE 26.8% over the identical window. But the risk did not disappear, it MOVED: 46% of HOOD's y/y growth now comes from event contracts, sitting under a Ninth Circuit panel that has signalled skepticism. The market is de-rating the wrong risk, in the wrong direction, at a price that already pays for being right.
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: The mix shift is legible only in the 10-Q Note-6 revenue disaggregation, one quarter in arrears, while index/basket flow — including 8 single-name leveraged/income ETFs on HOOD (HOOW, HOOY, HOOG, HOOX, HODU, HOYY, HOOZ, HOOC) — transmits crypto-complex selling continuously. Aggregation cost plus a 1-3 quarter latency is a real structural gap.
edge_explainer.why_it_might_be_priced_in: Largely IS. At 43.9x a FLAT FY26 EPS year and 33.6x FY27, HOOD is not priced as a broken crypto proxy — it is priced as a premium growth financial. The de-rate already took ~55x to 34x, so the crypto fear has been partly corrected. What is left is a fair price for a great franchise carrying an unpriced legal binary.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: The Ninth Circuit ruling (dominant, near-dated); then each quarter's Note-6 disaggregation as crypto's share falls.
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: HOOD's beta to BTC failing to DECAY across the next 2-3 prints while crypto's revenue share keeps falling would say the factor loading is not about crypto revenue at all — it is a pure positioning/liquidity phenomenon that fundamentals cannot dislodge, and this thesis has no catalyst.
edge_explainer.edge_type: diligence + a conditioned price gate; the position today is the WATCH

review_flags: Headline 'Diluted EPS up 48% to $0.62' — $0.14 (23% of EPS) is a one-time RVI deconsolidation gain; clean EPS $0.48 = +14%. Quantified in the very next sub-bullet, so honest but headline-flattering.

'net interest revenues increased 9%... partially offset by... securities lending activity' — securities lending net actually collapsed 81% ($54M -> $10M), a line that was 15% of net interest revenue. In the Note-6 table; the prose materially understates it.

'lowering and tightening our 2026 Adjusted Opex and SBC outlook to $2.675-2.775bn' — the outlook EXPLICITLY EXCLUDES provision for credit losses, the fastest-growing expense line (+100% y/y). Exclusion stated verbatim; reads as discipline while the carved-out bucket is the one compounding.

mode_b_findings: B-1 FACTOR MISCLASSIFICATION: market prices a 0.83 BTC beta against 7.6% crypto revenue. Masking channel = index/basket factor classification (8 single-name leveraged ETFs transmit crypto-complex flow); signal channel = the quarterly 10-Q Note-6 disaggregation; signal-to-price latency = 1-3 quarters.

B-2 RISK MIGRATION: 46% of y/y revenue growth (+$146M of +$319M) is event contracts, under live multi-jurisdiction injunction litigation — Nevada LOST (ceased new sports contracts 2025-12-01, 9th Cir. appeal pending), suits vs NJ/MA/MI/WA, tribal RICO dismissed May-2026, MSD investigating. Sports vs non-sports split NOT DISCLOSED = the top gap.

B-3 SELF-CANCELLING BALANCE-SHEET BUILD: margin book +127% to $21.6bn and a $17bn-purchase-volume card book produced net interest +$32M against credit provisions +$28M — net economic contribution ~+$4M/qtr. Risk up, return flat. Card net interest (+$27M) is fully consumed by the provision build (+$28M).

B-4 REFLEXIVE TAX RATE: 10-Q Note 9 confirms the sub-13% ETR came from 'excess tax benefits from SBC' at a $150 stock. Down 41%, the shield shrinks mechanically — a falling share price reduces EPS through the tax line independent of operations (ETR 11.2% -> 18.0% on 6M). A two-way reflexive amplifier no sell-side model isolates.

B-5 SCREEN SCORE IS AN ARTIFACT: 'gm 92%' is definitionally near-100% for a broker (brokerage+transaction expense = 4.7% of revenue) and carries zero information versus the software names it is ranked against; 'rev3y 48.8%' is a base effect (10-Q risk factors: first full-year GAAP net income was 2024). The 'quality-at-own-history-discount' frame needs an own-history multiple to revert to, and HOOD has ~2 years of profitability. HOOD is a +800% 3-year winner giving back 41%, not a fallen compounder. 97.9 is not evidence.
